arb.vpnDisclosure_body: FuzeVPN ikoresha serivisi ya VPN ya Android (VpnService) kugira ngo ikore umuyoboro w’ibanga hagati y’iki gikoresho na seriveri za FuzeVPN.
arb.vpnDisclosure_dataBody: Igihe VPN ikora, urujya n’uruza rw’interineti rwa porogaramu zanyu, aderesi z’aho zerekeza n’ibyifuzo bya DNS binyura muri uyu muyoboro kugira ngo ihuza ryanyu riyoborwe, n’iyo FuzeVPN ikorera inyuma.
arb.vpnDisclosure_statusBody: Porogaramu ikoresha uko ihuza rihagaze, igihe rimaze n’ingano y’amakuru yahererekanyijwe kugira ngo igaragaze ihuza ryanyu rya VPN. Mushobora guhagarika VPN igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
arb.accountRestoration_message: Igihe cyanyu cyo kwinjira cyabitswe. Mwongere mugerageze kugarura konti yanyu. Mushobora gukomeza gucunga ihuza rya VPN hano.
arb.session_ending: Igihe cyo kwinjira kirimo gusozwa: guhagarika VPN no gusukura…
arb.session_stopFailed: Guhagarika VPN ntibyemejwe. Mwongere mugerageze mbere yo kongera kwinjira.
arb.session_cleanupFailed: VPN yahagaritswe, ariko gukuraho igihe cyo kwinjira ntibyemejwe. Mwongere mugerageze gusukura.
arb.startup: FuzeVPN irimo gutegurwa mu buryo butekanye…
arb.auth_keysLocal: Imfunguzo zanyu z’ibanga za VPN ziguma kuri iki gikoresho.
arb.form_passwordMin: Bayiti 8–72 za UTF-8. Inyuguti zimwe zikoresha bayiti zirenze imwe.
arb.form_address2: Umurongo wa kabiri wa aderesi (si ngombwa)
arb.auth_requiredInformation: Mukore konti yanyu mu ntambwe eshatu.
arb.auth_consentRequired: Kwemera kwanyu birakenewe kugira ngo mukore konti.
arb.validation_password: Ijambobanga rigufi cyane: nibura bayiti 8 za UTF-8.
arb.validation_passwordTooLong: Ijambobanga rirerire cyane: ntirigomba kurenza bayiti 72 za UTF-8.
arb.validation_country: Mukoreshe kode y’igihugu y’inyuguti ebyiri, urugero: FR.
arb.passwordReset_description: Mwinjize aderesi y’imeyili ya konti yanyu kugira ngo musabe umurongo wo gushyiraho ijambobanga rishya.
arb.connection_subtitle: Muhitemo ahantu, hanyuma mufungure VPN yanyu.
arb.verification_message: Mwemeze aderesi y’imeyili yanyu kugira ngo mukoreshe VPN kuri iyi telefoni.
arb.migration_blocked: Guhindura ahantu bisaba ko hagira igikorwa kuri seriveri. Mwongere mugerageze nyuma cyangwa muvugane n’ubufasha.
arb.migration_retryDelay: Igihe cyo gutegereza hagati y’amagenzura: amasegonda {seconds}.
arb.status_authorizingDetail: Mwemere icyifuzo cya Android kugira ngo VPN yemererwe gukora.
arb.status_reconnectingDetail: Ihuza ryacitse. VPN irimo kugerageza kongera guhuza.
arb.status_connectingDetail: Irimo guhuza na seriveri ya VPN…
arb.status_disconnectingDetail: Ihuza ryanyu rya VPN ririmo guhagarara.
arb.status_errorDetail: Ihuza rya VPN ntiryemejwe. Mwongere mugerageze.
arb.status_idleDetail: Muhuze VPN kugira ngo murinde ihuza ryanyu.
arb.trust_note: Gufunga porogaramu ntibihagarika VPN. Kugira ngo muyihagarike, mukoreshe Guhagarika.
arb.locations_lockedTunnel: Muhagarike VPN kugira ngo muhindure ahantu.
arb.devices_empty: Nta gikoresho cya VPN kiranditswe kugeza ubu.
arb.devices_firstConnection: Telefoni yanyu izongerwamo igihe muzahuza bwa mbere.
arb.settings_subtitle: Ibyo mwihitiyemo na konti yanyu, byose biri ahantu hamwe.
arb.settings_languageDescription: Ururimi mwahisemo ruzakoreshwa no mu menyesha ya VPN.
arb.settings_licensesDetail: Porogaramu mudasobwa zikoreshwa muri iyi porogaramu
arb.settings_licensesLegalese: Kode y’inkomoko ya porogaramu n’iy’ibice byayo bifite uruhushya rwa MPL-2.0: {url}
arb.settings_background: Igihe muvuye muri porogaramu, VPN ikomeza gukora. Kugira ngo muyihagarike, mukoreshe Guhagarika ku gice cy’Ihuza.
arb.dialog_removeCurrent: Iyi telefoni izavanwa kuri VPN kandi izatakaza uburenganzira bwo kuyikoresha. Amakuru y’ihuza rya VPN yayo azakurwaho seriveri imaze kubyemeza.
arb.dialog_removeOther: Uburenganzira bwa VPN bwa “{name}” buzakurwaho. Ibi ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
arb.dialog_signOutMessage: VPN izahagarara kandi muzakenera kongera kwinjira. Imfunguzo zanyu za VPN zibitswe mu buryo bw’ibanga zizaguma kuri iyi telefoni kugira ngo muzazikoreshe ubutaha muzahuza.
arb.notice_sessionExpired_message: Igihe cyanyu cyo kwinjira cyarangiye. Mwongere mwinjire.
arb.notice_invalidCredentials_message: Aderesi y’imeyili cyangwa ijambobanga si byo.
arb.notice_emailVerification_message: Mwemeze aderesi y’imeyili yanyu mbere yo kongeramo igikoresho cya VPN.
arb.notice_deviceLimit_message: Mubanze mukureho igikoresho gisanzweho mbere yo kongeraho ikindi.
arb.notice_identityRenewal_message: Uyu mwirondoro wakuweho. Mukore umwirondoro mushya wo kuri iki gikoresho.
arb.notice_migrationBlocked_message: Guhindura ahantu bisaba ko hagira igikorwa kuri seriveri. Mwongere mugerageze nyuma cyangwa muvugane n’ubufasha.
arb.notice_networkUnavailable_message: Mugenzure ihuza ryanyu, hanyuma mwongere mugerageze.
arb.notice_permissionDenied_message: Mwongere mutangire ihuza, hanyuma mwemere icyifuzo cy’uruhushya rwa Android.
arb.notice_wireguardTimeout_message: Ihuza rya WireGuard ryafashe igihe kirekire cyane. Mwongere mugerageze cyangwa muhitemo ahandi hantu.
arb.notice_tlsFailed_message: Seriveri ntiyemeye ihuza rya OpenVPN. Mwongere mugerageze. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, mukore isuzuma.
arb.notice_tunRejected_message: Android yanze igenamiterere ry’urusobe OpenVPN yasabye.
arb.notice_openvpnStart_message: Moteri ya OpenVPN ntiyashoboye kurangiza gutangira. Mwongere mugerageze. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, muvugane n’ubufasha.

arb.notice_permissionRequestInProgress_messa: Icyifuzo cy’uruhushya rwa VPN ya Android kimaze kwerekanwa. Mukirangize mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

arb.protection_subtitle: Guhagarika kugera kuri interineti mu buryo butaziguye igihe VPN itakiri gukora.
arb.protection_alwaysOnOnly: VPN ihora ikora irafunguye. Mufungure uburyo bwo guhagarika ihuza ridafite VPN.
arb.protection_dialogMessage: Android icunga VPN ihora ikora n’uburyo bwo guhagarika ihuza ridafite VPN. Mugenzure ko FuzeVPN yatoranyijwe, hanyuma mufungure uburyo bwo guhagarika mu igenamiterere rya sisitemu.
arb.session_systemProtectionNote: Niba Android ikomeje guhagarika urujya n’uruza hanze ya VPN, mufungure igenamiterere rya sisitemu kugira ngo mugenzure cyangwa muhindure ubu burinzi.

arb.diagnostics_privacy: Raporo zoherejwe zihuzwa na konti mwinjiyemo kandi zibikwa iminsi 30. Nta mateka y’imbuga zasuwe, amagambobanga cyangwa imfunguzo za VPN zirimo.
arb.diagnostics_localDescription: Mukore raporo y’uko porogaramu na VPN bimeze. Ihuza ryanyu ntirihinduka.
arb.diagnostics_sendHint: Mureke iki gisanduku kitarimo ikimenyetso kugira ngo raporo igume kuri iki gikoresho.
arb.diagnostics_signedOut: Mwinjire muri konti yanyu kugira ngo mwohereze raporo.
arb.diagnostics_localLifetime: Mubike iyi raporo kuri telefoni yanyu kugira ngo ikomeze kuboneka nyuma yo gufunga porogaramu.
arb.diagnostics_failed: Kohereza ntibyashobotse. Raporo yanyu yo kuri iki gikoresho iracyaboneka.
arb.diagnostics_preparationFailed: Ntibyashobotse gutegura raporo y’isuzuma. Mwongere mugerageze.
arb.diagnostics_authenticationRequired: Mwongere mwinjire kugira ngo mwohereze raporo.
arb.diagnostics_exportFailed: Kubika raporo ntibyashobotse. Mwongere mugerageze mukoresheje raporo yo kuri iki gikoresho.

arb.connection_androidDisconnectHint: Niba Android ikomeje gutuma VPN ikora, muzimye “VPN ihora ikora” mu igenamiterere rifunguka.
arb.protection_learnMore: Mumenye byinshi ku burinzi bwa Android
arb.protection_guideWhy: Ubu burinzi bubuza porogaramu gukoresha interineti mu buryo butanyuze muri VPN, iyo VPN ihagaze. Bushyirwaho muri Android.
arb.protection_guideAlwaysOn: Android ituma serivisi ya VPN ikomeza gukora, kandi ishobora kongera kuyitangiza telefoni imaze gutangira bundi bushya.
arb.protection_guideBlock: Iri genamiterere ribuza urujya n’uruza kunyura hanze ya VPN, harimo n’igihe ihuza ryacitse.
arb.protection_guideWarning: Iyo ubu buryo bwo guhagarika bufunguye, interineti ntiboneka kugeza VPN ihujwe.
arb.protection_guideStep1: Mufungure igenamiterere rya VPN ya Android mukoresheje buto iri hasi.
arb.protection_guideStep2: Mufungure amahitamo mukoresheje agashushanyo k’igenamiterere kari hafi ya FuzeVPN.
arb.protection_guideStep3: Mufungure “VPN ihora ikora”, hanyuma “Guhagarika ihuza ridafite VPN”, niba ayo mahitamo ahari.
arb.protection_guideManufacturers: Amazina aratandukana bitewe na telefoni. Nibiba ngombwa, mushakishe VPN mu Igenamiterere, akenshi munsi ya Urusobe n’interineti.
arb.protection_guideDisable: Muri ayo magenamiterere, muzimye “Guhagarika ihuza ridafite VPN” kugira ngo mushobore gukoresha interineti nta VPN. Muzimye kandi “VPN ihora ikora” niba mutagishaka ko Android yongera kuyitangiza.
arb.protection_guideManual: Ayo magenamiterere muyahitamo ubwanyu muri Android. FuzeVPN ntihindura ayo magenamiterere mu cyimbo cyanyu.
arb.locations_changeActive: VPN izahagarika guhuza, hanyuma igerageze guhuza na {name}.
arb.locations_changeBusy: Hari impinduka irimo gukorwa. Mutegereze mbere yo guhitamo ahandi hantu.
arb.externalLink_failed: Ntibyashobotse gufungura uyu murongo. Mushobora kuwukopera mukawufungurira muri mushakisha yanyu.
arb.externalLink_copyFailed: Ntibyashobotse gukopera umurongo. Muhitemo aderesi iri hasi.

arb.guest_accountDescription: Mushobora gusubizaho ibyaguzwe byanyu mukoresheje konti imwe ya Google Play, kugira ngo mukoreshe ifatabuguzi ryanyu ku kindi gikoresho.
arb.guest_claimDescription: Mukore konti kugira ngo mubone ifatabuguzi ryanyu ku bindi bikoresho byanyu. Iyi ntambwe si itegeko.
arb.guest_activationDescription: Ifatabuguzi ryanyu ryiteguye. Mushobora gukoresha VPN yanyu kandi mugakora konti igihe mubishakiye.
arb.guest_loginRequired: Uku kugura kumaze guhuzwa na konti ya FuzeVPN. Mwinjire muri iyo konti kugira ngo mubone ifatabuguzi ryanyu.
arb.guest_signOutWarning: Mushobora kugarura ifatabuguzi ryanyu mu gusubizaho ibyaguzwe mukoresheje konti imwe ya Google Play.
arb.guest_profileUnavailable: Konti yanyu imaze guhuzwa. Mwinjire kugira ngo murebe kandi mucunge amakuru yanyu.
arb.billing_acceptance: Mu gukomeza, mwemera Amabwiriza yo gukoresha na Politiki y’ubuzima bwite.
arb.guest_verifyEmailReminder: Mwemeze aderesi y’imeyili yanyu kugira ngo murinde konti yanyu. Mushobora gukomeza gukoresha VPN yanyu.
arb.guest_serviceUnavailable: Serivisi ntiboneka by’agateganyo. Mwongere mugerageze mu kanya gato.
arb.guest_restoreError: Ibyaguzwe byanyu ntibyashoboye gusubizwaho. Mwongere mugerageze mukoresheje konti ya Google Play mwakoresheje mu kugura.
arb.guest_claimSuccess: Konti yanyu yakozwe. Ifatabuguzi ryanyu n’uburenganzira bwanyu bwa VPN birabitswe.
arb.guest_emailExists: Iyi aderesi y’imeyili isanzwe ikoreshwa. Muhitemo indi aderesi cyangwa mwinjire muri konti yanyu isanzwe ihari. Ukugura kwanyu kuracyaboneka binyuze kuri Google Play.
arb.guest_claimError: Ntibyashobotse gukora konti yanyu. Mushobora gukomeza gukoresha VPN yanyu, hanyuma mwongere mugerageze nyuma.
arb.guest_secureStorageError: Ntibyashobotse kurinda igihe cyanyu cyo kwinjira kuri iki gikoresho. Mwongere mugerageze.
arb.guest_premiumRequired: Muhitemo ifatabuguzi kugira ngo VPN yanyu ikore.
arb.google_profileDescription: Muhitemo igihugu cyanyu kandi musuzume inyandiko ebyiri kugira ngo mukore konti yanyu ya FuzeVPN.
arb.google_claimDescription: Muhuze konti yanyu y’umushyitsi na Google. Ifatabuguzi ryanyu n’igikoresho cyanyu bikomeza guhuzwa n’iyi konti.
arb.google_linkDescription: Mwemeze uburenganzira bwanyu bwo kwinjira muri konti yanyu isanzwe ya FuzeVPN. Iyi ntambwe ntisaba ijambobanga ryanyu rya Google.
arb.google_emailInstructions: Mufungure imeyili ya FuzeVPN, mwinjize kode yo kwemeza.
arb.google_unavailable: Kwinjira ukoresheje Google ntibiboneka. Mushobora gukoresha imeyili n’ijambobanga.
arb.google_expired: Iri gerageza ryarangiye igihe. Murireke, hanyuma mutangire bundi bushya.
arb.google_conflict: Iyi konti ya Google isanzwe ihujwe ahandi. Konti yanyu iriho n’ifatabuguzi ryanyu birabitswe.
arb.google_error: Kwinjira ukoresheje Google ntibyashobotse. Mwongere mugerageze. Uburenganzira bwanyu bugumaho.
arb.google_uncertain: Ibyavuye ntibyashobotse kwemezwa. Mugenzure iri gerageza cyangwa murireke mbere yo gutangira bundi bushya.
arb.google_cancelFailed: Ntibyashobotse kwemeza ko byahagaritswe. Mwongere mugerageze kureka mbere yo kuva kuri uru rupapuro.
arb.google_emailUnavailable: Imeyili yo kwemeza ntiyashoboye koherezwa. Mwongere mugerageze nyuma.
arb.google_emailSent: Imeyili yo kwemeza yoherejwe. Mugenzure agasanduku k’imeyili yanyu.
arb.google_busy: Google ntiboneka mu gihe ikindi gikorwa kirimo gukorwa (guhuza VPN, konti cyangwa umushyitsi). Mwongere mugerageze nyuma y’uko kirangiye. Uburenganzira bwanyu bugumaho.
arb.google_invalidPassword: Ijambobanga rya FuzeVPN si ryo. Konti yanyu iriho irabitswe.
arb.google_invalidCode: Kode yo kwemeza ntiyemewe cyangwa yararangiye.
arb.google_accountChanged: Igihe cyanyu cyo kwinjira cyarahindutse. Mureke iri gerageza mbere yo gutangira bundi bushya.
arb.google_invalidResponse: Igisubizo ntigishobora kwemezwa. Uburenganzira bwanyu bugumaho.
arb.google_invalidRegistration: Mugenzure igihugu cyanyu n’ibyo mwemeye byombi.
arb.google_consentRequired: Muhitemo igihugu cyanyu kandi mwemere inyandiko zombi kugira ngo mukomeze.
arb.google_challengeRequired: Hakenewe irindi genzura ry’umutekano. Uburenganzira bwanyu bugumaho.
arb.google_challengeUnavailable: Igenzura ry’umutekano ntiriboneka. Mwongere mugerageze nyuma.
arb.google_intentMismatch: Igerageza ryabanje ryo kwinjira ukoresheje Google riracyategereje. Murireke mbere yo gutangira iki gikorwa.
arb.google_challengeBlocked: Igenzura ry’umutekano risabwa ntiriboneka muri iyi porogaramu. Iki gikorwa ntigishobora kurangira ubu.
arb.google_challengeReady: Igenzura ryarangiye. Ubu mushobora kwemeza gukora konti yanyu.
arb.google_challengeExpired: Igenzura ryarangiye igihe. Mukore irindi genzura mbere yo kwemeza.
arb.google_challengeFailed: Igenzura ry’umutekano ntiryagenze neza. Mwongere mugerageze.
